customManagers.description: Writerside builder image. It is pinned as a bare env var in docs.yml, so no built-in manager sees it. Tracked against the Docker Hub mirror (jetbrains/writerside-builder); the workflow pulls the same tags from registry.jetbrains.team, which Renovate cannot enumerate. The mirror has carried every release so far — if it ever lags, the bump arrives late rather than wrong.

packageRules.description: Never auto-merge the Writerside builder. The org preset auto-merges non-majors once CI is green, but ci-required never builds the guide — docs.yml does, only on push to main. So a bad bump cannot fail CI; it breaks the published guide after merge. Overrides the preset rule.
prBodyNotes: :warning: **CI does not build the guide** — `ci-required` only classifies `Writerside/**` as docs-only. Build locally with the new image before merging and diff the inspection report against the current pin; the builder exits 0 even on document errors. See the verification recipe in [#2346](https://github.com/tractat-us/kuilt/pull/2346).
